conclusion: 今天的主线是“权限与模型都要进台账”：GitHub Enterprise 凭证清单导出把 token/key 风险变成可盘点资产；Grok 4.7 进入 Copilot 后，模型选择同时变成计费和组织策略事件；Copilot CLI 1.0.87/1.0.88 强化 prompt 队列、worktree、精确授权和网络拒绝解释；Codex alpha 已滚到 0.157.0-alpha.2，但稳定锚点仍是 0.155.1；OpenAI SDK/Agents 更新继续提醒我们把 vault、webhook、parser、resume、SQLite 和子进程清理写进运行验收。
excerpt: 2026-09-22 的重点是 Credential Inventory Incident Board、Model Picker Policy Ledger、CLI Permission Micro-Grant Receipt、Prompt Queue Worktree Contract、Alpha Stable Dual-Lane Gate。
白话说: 今天不是“又多了几个模型和版本”，而是办公室多了钥匙清单、车型上架清单、排队取号系统和试验车道；每一项都要留小票。

signals.title: GitHub Enterprise credential inventory exports
signals.author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
signals.summary: GitHub Enterprise owners can export an inventory of SSH keys, PATs, OAuth tokens, and GitHub App tokens, with owner, scope, date, target, and audit-log correlation fields.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Build a credential inventory review loop before incident response, not after a token leak.

signals.title: Grok 4.7 is available in GitHub Copilot
signals.author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
signals.summary: Grok 4.7 is rolling out to Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise across IDE, CLI, cloud agent, app, JetBrains, Xcode, and Eclipse surfaces, billed at provider list pricing.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Treat every new model-picker entry as a policy and cost event; confirm admin enablement and billing before pilots.

signals.title: Copilot CLI 1.0.88-1
signals.author: GitHub Copilot CLI Releases
signals.summary: Copilot CLI 1.0.88-1 preserves /allow-all during managed-settings refresh failures, records exact approvals for missing paths without granting the parent directory, and explains sandboxed network denials from proxy tunnel failures.
signals.takeaway: 动作: In CLI agent receipts, distinguish exact path grants from parent-directory grants and record network-denial bypass guidance.

signals.title: Copilot CLI 1.0.87 stable
signals.author: GitHub Copilot CLI Releases
signals.summary: Copilot CLI 1.0.87 adds Auto routing startup defaults and org policy controls, recallable pending prompts, worktreePathTemplate, task forking during active turns, and more explicit session deletion behavior.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Split prompt queue, worktree creation, auto routing, and session deletion into separate, reviewable operating receipts.

signals.title: OpenAI Codex 0.157.0-alpha.2
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub Releases
signals.summary: Codex alpha moved into the 0.157.0 line on 2026-09-21, while the latest stable release remains 0.155.1; alpha release bodies are sparse and need disposable-workspace testing before use.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Keep 0.157 alpha as an observation lane and anchor production behavior on 0.155.1 until a specific fix justifies smoke testing.

signals.title: OpenAI Codex 0.155.1 stable
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub Releases
signals.summary: Codex 0.155.1 restores the local TUI default to disable reasoning summaries, avoiding provider request rejection when a provider does not support summary fields while respecting explicit settings.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Add provider-capability preflight before enabling reasoning summaries, especially in mixed-provider or gateway setups.

signals.title: ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.251 Codex updates
signals.author: OpenAI Codex Changelog
signals.summary: The Codex changelog reports iOS 1.2026.251 improvements around task detail layout, queued prompt display, and remembering the previously selected worktree mode for new tasks.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Let iPhone handle dispatch and status checks, but keep Mac/Codex as the final evidence gate for file, test, commit, push, and deploy.

signals.title: Upcoming Copilot model deprecations
signals.author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
signals.summary: Selected Copilot models, including GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3.7 Flash, and Grok 4.5, are scheduled for deprecation on 2026-10-19 with suggested replacements.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Create a dated model migration board for prompts, agents, policies, fixtures, and fallback models before 2026-10-19.

signals.title: OpenAI Node 7.20.0
signals.author: OpenAI SDKs
signals.summary: OpenAI Node 7.20.0 adds environment-variable vault credentials, external storage configuration management, safety case retrieval, safety warning/deactivation webhook events, and SIP media security fields.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Treat SDK upgrades as operations-surface changes that need owner, permission, environment, and readback records.

signals.title: OpenAI Python 3.16.2
signals.author: OpenAI SDKs
signals.summary: OpenAI Python 3.16.2 fixes a parse_response memory leak caused by TextFormatT parameterization, following 3.16.0 webhook endpoint management additions.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Include parser memory behavior and webhook endpoint management in Python SDK upgrade smoke tests.

signals.title: OpenAI Agents Python 0.22.3
signals.author: OpenAI / Agents SDK
signals.summary: Agents Python 0.22.3 fixes conditional approvals, server-managed resume output, async SQLite startup, tracing API-key caching, AdvancedSQLiteSession tool usage, subprocess reaping, and Unix-local execution docs.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Add approval, resume, SQLite concurrency, tool-usage ledger, and subprocess cleanup to runtime smoke fixtures.

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.278
signals.author: Anthropic / GitHub Releases
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.278 defaults auto mode to the server-side classifier for several provider paths, adds a status row for classifier location, and warns on billed fallback.

knowledge.title: Credential Inventory Incident Board
knowledge.label: ACCESS OPS
knowledge.body: 把 SSH key、PAT、OAuth token、GitHub App token 做成可导出的权限资产清单，并和审计日志关联。
knowledge.summary: 凭证先盘点，事故才不乱。
steps: 按 owner、credential type、scope、created_at、expires_at、last_used 和 target org/repo 建表。
把 export CSV/API readback、过滤条件和 audit-log 关联方式写进操作记录。
事件响应时先冻结受影响凭证集合，再决定 revoke、rotate 或通知范围。
公开报告只写能力和方法，不写真实凭证名、用户邮箱或组织私密路径。
knowledge.risk: 没有统一凭证清单时，事故响应会靠人工猜测，容易漏掉 app token 或细粒度 PAT。

knowledge.title: Model Picker Policy Ledger
knowledge.label: MODEL COST
knowledge.body: 每个新进入模型选择器的模型，都同时是权限、计费、可用面和回归测试事件。
knowledge.summary: 新模型上架要先看政策。
steps: 记录模型、可用 SKU、入口面、provider list pricing、usage-based billing 和 admin policy。
在 Business/Enterprise 环境先读 policy，再做 pilot，不默认相信全局自动启用。
用固定任务比较质量、延迟、费用和工具兼容性。
把模型启用、禁用、替代和退役日期放在同一张迁移表。
knowledge.risk: 只看到模型名就试用，可能绕过预算、组织策略或固定回归基线。

knowledge.title: CLI Permission Micro-Grant Receipt
knowledge.label: CLI SAFETY
knowledge.body: CLI agent 的授权要精确到路径和网络条件，不能把缺失路径误扩成父目录权限。
steps: 记录 exact path grant、parent directory grant、allow-all 状态和刷新失败时的保留规则。
把 /list-dirs、/reset-allowed-tools 和 network denial 文案保存为本地验收证据。
代理遇到 proxy tunnel/network denial 时先解释绕行条件，不直接放宽沙箱。
权限刷新失败后复读实际有效权限，避免 UI 文案和执行权限分叉。
knowledge.risk: 把一个文件的缺失路径授权扩大成父目录，会让后续代理读写范围悄悄变大。

knowledge.title: Prompt Queue Worktree Contract
knowledge.label: SESSION OPS
knowledge.body: 长任务里的排队提示、撤回编辑、fork 和 worktree 模板要分开记录，避免会话恢复时弄错现场。
knowledge.summary: 长任务像排队取号，要有票根。
steps: 记录 pending prompts、queued prompts、recall 操作和当前处理中的 prompt。
为 /worktree、/move、/new 和 --worktree 固定模板，并保存 repo/branch 展开结果。
active turn 中 fork 任务时，注明父任务状态、子任务目标和写入边界。
删除/关闭 session 前区分本地永久删除和服务端 conversation 保留。
knowledge.risk: 提示队列和 worktree 规则混在一起，会导致恢复后在错误目录或错误任务继续写。

knowledge.title: Alpha Stable Dual-Lane Gate
knowledge.label: RUNTIME ROUTING
knowledge.body: alpha 版本看方向，stable 版本做默认；两条证据线不能混写。
knowledge.summary: 试验车和通勤车分开开。
steps: 记录最新 alpha、最新 stable、发布时间、release body 丰富度和目标问题。
没有明确修复点时，只写观察，不建议升级。
如需试验，用 disposable workspace 和最小 fixture，不污染默认工作流。
报告里把 alpha 观察、stable 默认和本地 smoke 结论分栏。
knowledge.risk: alpha 连续滚动不等于适合生产；把 alpha 结果当 stable 证据会误导升级决策。
